name: TTS_03_Visual_And_Clip_Factory
description: TikTok-Shop Visual & Clip Factory (hybrid): analyze-reference -> per-scene Ling-3.0-flash-VL HTTP vision gate (rejects overlays/screens/mismatches) -> assemble best clips + packshot CTA; <2 verified = blocked_no_reference.

parameters.jsonBody: ={"model":"inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL","temperature":0,"max_tokens":600,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Judge this frame from a product demo video for reuse in a German TikTok Shop ad for: {{$json.__product_name}}. Answer ONLY JSON {\"ok\":true|false,\"reason\":\"max 10 words\"} - no explanation before or after. ok=false if the frame shows: screenshot/receipt/order page, baked-in text overlays or comment stickers, phone/computer screen recording, a clearly different product type, no physical product visible, or mostly logo/graphic cards. ok=true only if a real physical matching-type product is visibly used or held."},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"{{$json.frame_url}}"}}]}]}
